summary: fractal uninstall removes the legacy st3.sock and st3-client.sock names and their reservation locks beside the daemon's sockets

rules.detail: No runtime or policy rule changes.

compatibility.detail: The daemon still serves and reserves the legacy socket names as before; uninstall, which runs only after the daemon stopped, now also removes those names and their lock files.

downtime.detail: No runtime deployment or migration changes.

manual.detail: No user action is required. An earlier uninstall may have left st3.sock, st3-client.sock or their .reservation.lock files in the runtime directory; they are inert and may be deleted.

recovery.detail: Revert the change; the files only stay behind again.
